ideas.title: The friends pull my first cart up the dune, then the motor drags them back down
ideas.critique: This is round 2's cart pull again, now with worked Bekker numbers showing that a 15 kg cart with riders does sink about a centimetre, which answers the fear that the ruts would show nothing, and with one traction rule for any creature on any ground. The payoff is the same, Truffle sliding down on its belly, and it still depends on the poses actually coming from the rope force: soil constants written in for one sand and a lean that only tilts the body would make it a rig with friends glued to a rope.

ideas.title: A lift up the cairn that brakes itself on the way down
ideas.critique: This is the cairn lift a third time. The flat platform, which friends reach with their normal walk, and a load that is just whatever contact force stands on it, deal with the staged-boarding risk without new animation. Braking that comes out of the back-EMF with no brake code is still its strong and general part. The scene is a rope on one vertical axis at one fixed place, and the 'wants a view' mood that sends friends to the platform can easily turn into a trigger that marches them there on cue.
